mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.16% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 1.16%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.0% signals labor market tightness, increasing corporate profit margins and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous manufacturing output expansion (INDPRO > 100) and labor force growth (PAYEMS > 146,000) indicate robust economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 AND PAYEMS > 146,000 but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245) indicates stable real rates, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 245 but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,200 thousand units signal consumer confidence and spending strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1,200 but 5-day returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 95) signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95 but 60-day returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing market strength (HOUST > 1,200) and manufacturing expansion (INDPRO > 100) indicate broad-based economic health, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1,200 AND INDPRO > 100 but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) increase discount rates for equity cash flows, yielding negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days in monetary tightening regimes.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 2.0% but 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases.
